newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Maybank stock up on strong earnings.
newsitem.headline: Maybank stock up on strong earnings.

text.p: Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) stock rose 75 cents or 2.7 percent at its opening on Monday after the bank announced stronger than expected half year results at the weekend, dealers said.
After five minutes, the stock was trading at 28.50 ringgit, up from Friday's close of 27.75 ringgit.

Maybank, Malaysia's biggest banking group, on Saturday reported a net profit of 654.57 million ringgit in the first half of its year ending June 30, 1997, up 39 percent from 469.69 million ringgit in the previous period.
The results exceeded forecasts by most analysts who were expecting a net profit of about 580-600 million ringgit.
"Given the good outlook and positive developments that are in the pipeline after the Kwong Yik sale, we are reiterating our long term buy on Maybank," said Jupiter Research.
Maybank is selling its 75 percent stake in Kwong Yik Bank Bhd to stockbroking group Rashid Hussain Bhd for 2.16 billion ringgit.
